preRegistered: squad12-core.mjs RULES + data/strategy-library.json SQ12-* (24 Oct 2026, before any run)
standard: Per trade: entry next open after the signal session, exit close of session 63; both halves by signal date (before / from 2024-01-01): > 0 after 0.8% and 1.2%, better than the average liquid stock over the same sessions, better than the same stock held 63 sessions on its other days, > 0 without the 2 best, 20+ trades and 3+ blocks, block t >= 2.5 (63-session blocks) -> TRADABLE SMALL; >= 4.07 -> PROVEN; plus return per year of capital tied up above SPY on the same days in both halves (perYear). All gross returns capped at +300% on both sides (AUD-1 capBoth); uncapped = sensitivity. Universe: top 300 by point-in-time market value (top-100 cut = information).
halalNote: No point-in-time halal status exists in the repository; the tests run on the largest companies regardless of halal status. Today's signals carry the owner's ZAD mark.
